This is a **working Quarto migration** of existing BankUnited handoff materials, prepared November 13, 2026. It is not a final sponsor-approved release.

**Reference release:** `integrated-v0.2` — reported and owner-confirmed commit `3c48fd512e9a0bf9b43a2ec5755c7145bee9833e`.

**Navigation:** Read the scope chapter first, then follow the technical runbook, data and methodology chapters, validation evidence and acceptance checklist.

**Source of truth:** Existing code, tests, data artifacts and `.pbix` remain in the main repository. This Quarto project consolidates *documentation*, not executable product artifacts.

**Evidence:** See the original files retained one directory above in `docs/handoff/`. Content here is migrated from the November 12 documentation package and the November 11 repository ZIP. Any missing material is explicitly marked as pending.
